title: Vividly Smoky Dutch Millet Pilaf
description: A comforting Dutch dish featuring millet, with a smoky flavor and briny taste, perfect for a cold evening, and friendly to dairy-free diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the rinsed millet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the millet is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
